hypothesis: Cannon bones of ox, sheep and giraffe differ by a simple uniaxial stretch.
pass_criterion: After scaling to equal length, the width ratio sheep/ox is 0.67 +/- 0.1 and giraffe/ox is 0.33 +/- 0.1, with Procrustes residual after uniaxial affine fit below 5% of centroid size.
fail_criterion: Width ratios outside those ranges by more than 0.2, or residual above 10%.
interpretation: Needs metacarpal and metatarsal measurements or 3D scans for three species. No dataset was fetched.
no_dataset_reason: I did not find and fetch a public dataset with comparable cannon-bone measurements for ox, sheep and giraffe.
